about: Settings' Software Update (docs/adr/0030-installing-applications.mdx, decision 16) on a real oxyos-installd: the OS's row says this development install updates with apt (never a fake OS update); Inbox 1 is installed and the store publishes 2; Check for Updates reads the store once and lists Inbox 2 with its size (only what the machine lacks); Update All switches it: the apps are up to date, Inbox's row staying where it was, its control saying it updated (as the App Store keeps Updated Recently), Update All gone. At 1.25 on the ThinkPad's display (1600x1000).

steps.name: Software Update: the OS's row, and nothing checked yet

texts: This development install updates with apt.
absent: Your apps are up to date.

steps.name: The update listed: Inbox 2, what it fetches, Update All, waited for until the store's answer shows, however long reading it takes
Up to date: Inbox kept where it was, its control now saying it updated, as the App Store keeps Updated Recently; waited for until the update ends, however long fetching and compiling take

texts: Your apps are up to date.
